notes.title: New update is already available!
notes.notes:
The game is updated to the latest version.

I made a lot of edits to make the game more enjoyable.

Negative results will now happen less often. Nobody will deceive you anymore while shopping.

Random events will occur more often. And they no longer repeat. Now you can much better explore the streets of Staighrem and try out different options for action.

The complexity of the mini-games is reduced: no more killed mouses. :)

The frequency of crimes attacks in the later stages of the game is reduced. The probability of winning in a casino is increased. Also, minor bugs were fixed.

Thanks for your feedback!
